'''The Electric Tale of Pikachu issue 1''' is the first monthly issue of the manga series [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]] to be released by [[VIZ Media]]. It contains the first chapter of the manga, ''[[ET01|Pikachu, I See You!]]''. This along with the next three chapters would be later recollected in graphic novel format by VIZ Media into {{vol|Electric Tale of Pikachu|1}}.

==Chapters==

==Important events==
* [[Ash Ketchum (EToP)|Ash]] and [[Gary Oak|Gary]] begin their journeys.
* Ash gets a [[Ash's Pikachu (EToP)|Pikachu]].
* Ash meets {{an|Misty}}.
* Ash steals Misty's bike, and then wrecks it.
* Ash reaches [[Viridian City]].
* Ash catches a {{AP|Fearow}}.

==Translation edits==
When this issue was originally published, few changes were made to the original artwork. [[Daisy Oak|May Oak]] was depicted with large breasts, and {{an|Misty}}'s top revealed some cleavage. When [[Electric Tale of Pikachu volume 1|the collected volume]] was later released, however, May's breasts were redrawn to be much smaller and Misty's top was recolored to a black one which does not reveal any cleavage.
